hero.title: DARÉ
hero.subtitle: A sonic installation by Shumba Maasai

about.title: The Daré
paragraphs: A daré is a place of gathering. In Shona life it is where a community sits together to listen, to speak and to settle what matters: in the round, close to the ground, with a fire at the centre.
For one week in October 2026 a daré is built in London and filled with sound. Step inside and the city falls away. The work moves around you in the dark, and asks only that you sit with it.

artist.title: The Artist
artist.name: Shumba Maasai
artist.bio: Shumba Maasai is a Zimbabwean-born, London-based artist working across music, sound and performance. DARÉ is his first installation.
